highlights.reason_zh: 低价批量决策 API 可简化路由与审核，但 beta 接口和厂商自测要求先做本地校准。
highlights.reason_en: A low-cost batch decision API can simplify routing and moderation, but its beta contract and vendor results require local calibration.

highlights.reason_zh: AWS 将网页检索纳入 IAM 管控平面并正式收费开放，适合直接与现有搜索 provider 做成本和质量对照。
highlights.reason_en: AWS puts web retrieval inside its IAM control plane with GA pricing, making it directly comparable with existing search providers.

highlights.reason_zh: 小团队公开大型 agent 模型权重与部署路径，提供可复跑方案，但硬件门槛与独立评测仍是限制。
highlights.reason_en: A small team published large agent-model weights and a deployment path, creating a reproducible option limited by hardware and missing independent evaluation.

highlights.reason_zh: ERNIE 5.5 Flash 已有低价长上下文 API，但仍是未完成预览版，承诺的开放权重尚未兑现。
highlights.reason_en: ERNIE 5.5 Flash has a low-cost long-context API, but it is an unfinished preview and promised open weights have not shipped.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功并读完，并补搜 AWS、中文一手材料、小团队、开源、研究、基础设施、政策与重大综合新闻。Gemini 与 ERNIE 页面只有日期精度；最新 arXiv digest 仍停在 11 月 10 日；厂商 benchmark 尚待独立复现。 召回自检另补录 ZONOS3-Mini；NVIDIA CEO 交接作为重大综合新闻在日报补充，不伪造事件 ID。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were read, with added discovery across AWS, Chinese primary sources, small teams, open source, research, infrastructure, policy and major general news. Gemini and ERNIE pages have date-only precision; the newest arXiv digest still stops at November 10; vendor benchmarks await independent reproduction. Recall audit also added ZONOS3-Mini; NVIDIA's CEO transition is covered in the daily report as major general news without a fabricated event ID.
